source_text: 对ToR [职权范围]的简短审查帮助医疗规划人员解读关于受污染水井的迟报，同时没有延误分阶段放行货物。
target_text: A short review of ToR [Terms of Reference] helped medical planners interpret late reports of contaminated wells without delaying a phased cargo release.

source_text: 东部医院服务区报告一夜之间发生变化后，公共卫生团队将CONOPS [行动构想]与更好的交接说明联系起来。
target_text: public health teams linked CONOPS [Concept of Operations] to a better handover note after reports from the eastern hospital catchment changed overnight.

source_text: 临时桥梁地点的情况要求NFP [国家联络点]澄清河口附近涨潮是否改变了响应顺序。
target_text: The situation in the temporary bridge site required NFP [National Focal Point] to clarify whether high tide near the river mouth changed the response sequence.

source_text: 地震发生后，HADR [人道主义援助与灾害救援]团队先专注于救命援助，然后再转向早期恢复。
target_text: After the earthquake, HADR [Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] teams focused on life-saving assistance before shifting to early recovery.

source_text: 当多项支援提议同时到达时，区域伙伴通过Changi RHCC [樟宜区域人道主义援助与灾害救援协调中心]进行协调。
target_text: Regional partners coordinated through the Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] when multiple offers of support arrived at once.

source_text: 受灾政府向US INDOPACOM [美国印度洋-太平洋司令部]请求为偏远山区社区提供重型吊运支援。
target_text: The affected government requested heavy-lift support from US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] for isolated mountain communities.

source_text: PLA [中国人民解放军]的一份联络说明澄清了在伙伴支援转向北部公社前，应如何安排各方支援提议的先后顺序。
target_text: A liaison note from PLA [People's Liberation Army] clarified how partner offers should be sequenced before partner support moved toward the northern communes.

source_text: AHA Centre [东盟灾害管理人道主义援助协调中心]的态势更新帮助东盟伙伴协调救援优先事项。
target_text: Situation updates from the AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] helped align relief priorities across ASEAN partners.

source_text: 政府部委和人道主义机构参加了由UN OCHA [联合国人道主义事务协调厅]主持的协调电话会议。
target_text: Government ministries and humanitarian agencies joined the coordination call hosted by UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs].

source_text: 在受损地区，ASEAN-ERAT [东盟应急响应与评估队]在调拨额外物资前核实了避难所需求。
target_text: In the damaged district, ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] verified shelter needs before additional supplies were dispatched.

source_text: 任务分配板将ACMC [澳大利亚军民中心]记录为山区道路走廊避难所支援的关键协调联系人。
target_text: The tasking board recorded ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] as the key coordination contact for shelter support in the mountain road corridor.

source_text: 河中岛村落报告一夜之间发生变化后，区级官员将ToR [职权范围]与修订后的分发窗口联系起来。
target_text: district officers linked ToR [Terms of Reference] to a revised distribution window after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: 卫生组请求WHO [世界卫生组织]审查疾病监测计划。
target_text: The health cluster asked WHO [World Health Organization] to review the disease surveillance plan.

source_text: 地方当局与WFP [世界粮食计划署]协调，向撤离中心运送食品包。
target_text: Local authorities coordinated with WFP [World Food Programme] to deliver food packages to evacuation centres.

source_text: 当仓库附近不安全碎片使省级仓库区规划更难预测时，后勤文员采用了ToR [职权范围]。
target_text: logistics clerks applied ToR [Terms of Reference] when unsafe debris near a warehouse made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: 在捐助方协调会议期间，USAID BHA [美国国际开发署人道主义援助局]审查了紧急避难补助。
target_text: Emergency shelter grants were reviewed by USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] during the donor coordination meeting.

source_text: 区域防务官员在ADMM-Plus [东盟防长扩大会议]框架下讨论了HADR准备情况。
target_text: Regional defence officials discussed HADR readiness under the ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] framework.

source_text: EWG on HADR [人道主义援助与灾害救援专家工作组]的经验教训被加入演习评估矩阵。
target_text: Lessons from the EWG on HADR [Experts' Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] were added to the exercise evaluation matrix.

source_text: 救援队长在划分搜索区段前查阅了INSARAG [国际搜索与救援咨询组]指导。
target_text: The rescue team leader checked INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] guidance before assigning search sectors.

source_text: 会议记录通过ASEAN Secretariat [东盟秘书处]转送，以便正式分发。
target_text: Meeting notes were routed through the ASEAN Secretariat [Central administrative body for ASEAN] for official distribution.

source_text: AMRG on HADR [东盟军队人道主义援助与灾害救援待命组]对可部署的医疗和工程单位进行了编目。
target_text: Deployable medical and engineering units were catalogued by the AMRG on HADR [ASEAN Militaries Ready Group on HADR].

source_text: 水井受污染后，东道国请求SAF [新加坡武装部队]提供净水支援。
target_text: The host nation requested water purification support from SAF [Singapore Armed Forces] after wells were contaminated.

source_text: 来自PLA [中国人民解放军]的工程设备被分配用于恢复河流渡口通行。
target_text: Engineering equipment from the PLA [People's Liberation Army] was assigned to restore access to the river crossing.

source_text: 在响应高峰期，每日区域任务分配通过JOCCA [东盟联合行动协调中心]进行协调。
target_text: Daily regional tasking was coordinated through JOCCA [Joint Operations and Coordination Centre of ASEAN] during the peak response period.

source_text: 在实地演练期间，SCDF [新加坡民防部队]演示了坍塌结构搜索程序。
target_text: Collapsed-structure search procedures were demonstrated by SCDF [Singapore Civil Defence Force] during the field drill.

source_text: 国家指挥所向VINASARCOM [越南国家民防指导委员会]报告了所有国际支援提议。
target_text: The national command post reported all international offers to VINASARCOM [Vietnam's National Steering Committee for Civil Defense].

source_text: VDDMA [越南灾害与堤防管理局]提出的防洪优先事项影响了水泵和沙袋的分配。
target_text: Flood defence priorities from VDDMA [Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority] shaped the allocation of pumps and sandbags.

source_text: 主要补给路线失效后，VPA [越南人民军]工程兵提供了桥梁修复支援。
target_text: Bridge repair support was provided by VPA [Vietnam People's Army] engineers after the main supply route failed.

source_text: 来自MARD [农业与农村发展部]的农业损失数据为早期恢复规划提供了依据。
target_text: Agricultural loss data from MARD [Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development] informed early recovery planning.

source_text: 来自MOT [交通运输部]的道路清障更新被加入共同作战图像。
target_text: Road clearance updates from MOT [Ministry of Transport] were added to the common operating picture.

source_text: 直升机起飞前，MOH [卫生部]批准了医疗后送优先事项。
target_text: Medical evacuation priorities were approved by MOH [Ministry of Health] before helicopters launched.

source_text: DRRP [越南减灾伙伴关系]下的恢复伙伴确定了韧性项目的优先公社。
target_text: Recovery partners under DRRP [Vietnam Disaster Risk Reduction Partnership] identified priority communes for resilience programming.

source_text: 由QPT [自然灾害预防社区基金]支持的备灾信息传达到滑坡易发地区的住户。
target_text: Preparedness messaging supported by QPT [Community Fund for Natural Disaster Prevention] reached households in landslide-prone areas.

source_text: VNRC [越南红十字会]的急救队在学校避难所协助老年撤离人员。
target_text: First aid teams from VNRC [Vietnam Red Cross] assisted elderly evacuees at the school shelter.

source_text: 来自VAMS [越南医疗服务管理局]的医院准备情况报告在晚间卫生简报中进行了共享。
target_text: Hospital readiness reports from VAMS [Vietnam Administration of Medical Service] were shared during the evening health briefing.

source_text: 行动交接采用WoG [全政府方式]格式，整合了交通、卫生和防务官员关于沿海地区的更新。
target_text: The operational handover used a WoG [Whole-of-Government] format to combine coastal district updates from transport, health, and defence officials.

source_text: 国际伙伴等待NDMO [国家灾害管理办公室]确认正式需求清单。
target_text: International partners waited for the NDMO [National Disaster Management Office] to confirm the official needs list.

source_text: 当来自省会的更新相互矛盾时，CMCoord [军民协调]为规划人员提供了更清晰的优先事项比较方法。
target_text: When updates from the provincial capital conflicted, CMCoord [Civil-Military Coordination] gave planners a clearer way to compare priorities.

source_text: 规划人员在晨间协调周期分配救援物资发放责任前，审查了Mil-Mil [军事对军事协调]。
target_text: Planners reviewed Mil-Mil [Military-to-Military coordination] before assigning responsibility for relief distribution during the morning coordination cycle.

source_text: 受损无线电中继站暴露出临时桥梁地点规划弱点后，响应团队审查了Civ-Mil [民事-军事协调]。
target_text: The response team reviewed Civ-Mil [Civilian-Military coordination] after a damaged radio repeater exposed a weakness in planning for the temporary bridge site.

source_text: 当公共卫生团队报告河口附近涨潮时，AS [受灾国]成为确定更小搜索区域的参考依据。
target_text: When public health teams reported high tide near the river mouth, AS [Affected State] became the reference point for a narrower search area.

source_text: 在评估负责人质疑山路绕行线报告后，MNCC [多国协调中心]提供了缺失的背景信息。
target_text: MNCC [Multi-National Coordination Centre] provided the missing context after assessment leads questioned reports from the hill road bypass.

source_text: 区级报告在全国简报开始前送达EOC [应急行动中心]。
target_text: District reports reached the EOC [Emergency Operations Centre] before the national briefing began.

source_text: 该省提交了一份RFA [援助请求]，请求提供水处理设备和流动医疗队。
target_text: The province submitted an RFA [Request for Assistance] for water treatment units and mobile medical teams.

source_text: 避难所入住人数在指挥官更新前被加入COP [共同作战图像]。
target_text: Shelter occupancy figures were added to the COP [Common Operating Picture] before the commanders' update.

source_text: 团队重新审视SAR [搜索与救援]，因为救护车组短缺影响了捐助方代表规划较短指挥官简报的方式。
target_text: The team revisited SAR [Search and Rescue] because a shortage of ambulance crews affected how donor representatives planned a shorter commander update.

source_text: 倒塌公寓楼需要额外的USAR [城市搜索与救援]犬只和技术搜索设备。
target_text: The collapsed apartment block required additional USAR [Urban Search and Rescue] dogs and technical search equipment.

source_text: 受损无线电中继站暴露出北部撤离带规划弱点后，响应团队审查了AS [受灾国]。
target_text: The response team reviewed AS [Affected State] after a damaged radio repeater exposed a weakness in planning for the northern evacuation belt.

source_text: 在清理瓦砾开始前，响应人员检查是否存在CBRE [化学、生物、放射性及爆炸影响]危害。
target_text: Before debris clearance began, responders checked whether CBRE [Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Explosive impact] hazards were present.

source_text: 当绕行路上方发生泥石流时，PLA [中国人民解放军]与救援主管在低洼集镇就较小评估小组开展工作。
target_text: When mudslides above the bypass emerged, PLA [People's Liberation Army] worked with rescue supervisors on a smaller assessment team in a low-lying market town.

source_text: 应急厕所和清洁供水点在部门计划中被归入WASH [水、环境卫生与个人卫生]。
target_text: Emergency latrines and clean water points were grouped under WASH [Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene] in the sector plan.

source_text: 毛毯、睡垫和厨房套装被登记为NFI [非食品物资]库存。
target_text: Blankets, sleeping mats, and kitchen sets were recorded as NFI [Non-Food Items] stocks.

source_text: HOC [人道主义行动中心]就桥梁受损提供了重点更新，帮助团队调整临时集结基地的优先事项。
target_text: HOC [Humanitarian Operations Centre] contributed a focused update on bridge damage, which helped the team adjust priorities for the temporary staging base.

source_text: 仓库管理人员向LCC [后勤协调中心]报告了燃油和卡车短缺情况。
target_text: Warehouse managers reported fuel and truck shortages to the LCC [Logistics Coordination Centre].

source_text: 团队重新审视COP [共同作战图像]，因为MSR附近一处堵塞涵洞影响了仓库管理人员规划平衡部门优先事项说明的方式。
target_text: The team revisited COP [Common Operating Picture] because a blocked culvert near the MSR affected how warehouse managers planned a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: 医院演练升级为包含模拟创伤患者的MASCAS [大规模伤亡事件]情景。
target_text: The hospital drill escalated into a MASCAS [Mass Casualty Incident] scenario with simulated trauma patients.

source_text: 入境救援队在部署过程中受益于互认机制 [USAR队伍认证协议]。
target_text: Incoming rescue teams benefited from Mutual Recognition [Certification agreement for USAR teams] during the deployment process.

source_text: 救援货物先通过APOD [空中卸载港]，随后由卡车运往内陆。
target_text: Relief cargo moved through the APOD [Aerial Port of Disembarkation] before being trucked inland.

source_text: 后勤团队通过SPOD [海上卸载港]转运重型设备，以减轻机场拥堵。
target_text: The logistics team shifted heavy equipment through the SPOD [Sea Port of Disembarkation] to reduce airfield congestion.

source_text: 工程人员重新开放了连接省级仓库和撤离区域的MSR [主要补给路线]。
target_text: Engineers reopened the MSR [Main Supply Route] linking the provincial warehouse to the evacuation area.

source_text: 入境响应人员在前往集结基地前完成了CIQ [海关、移民与检疫]检查。
target_text: Incoming responders completed CIQ [Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine] checks before moving to the staging base.

source_text: 政府接受了MCDA [军事与民防资产]支援，用于运输、工程和医疗后送。
target_text: The government accepted MCDA [Military and Civil Defence Assets] support for transport, engineering, and medical evacuation.

source_text: 通过将HuMOCC [人道主义军事行动协调概念]作为协调参考，人道主义优先事项得到保护。
target_text: Humanitarian priorities were protected by using HuMOCC [Humanitarian-Military Operational Coordination Concept] as the coordination reference.

source_text: 警方、法医专家和卫生人员组成了DVI [灾难遇难者身份识别]协调组。
target_text: Police, forensic specialists, and health staff formed the DVI [Disaster Victim Identification] coordination group.

source_text: 村庄领导告知LEMA [地方应急管理机构]，一个避难所的饮用水已经耗尽。
target_text: Village leaders informed LEMA [Local Emergency Management Authority] that one shelter had run out of drinking water.

source_text: Ex COORES [协调响应演习]参与者在现实的区域灾害情景下练习决策。
target_text: Participants in Ex COORES [Exercise Coordinated Response] practiced decision-making under a realistic regional disaster scenario.

source_text: 当道路限重不确定使省级仓库区规划更难预测时，联络官采用了TTX [桌面推演]。
target_text: liaison officers applied TTX [Table-Top Exercise] when uncertain road weight limits made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: 聚集性发热病例暴露出受损渡口规划弱点后，响应团队审查了OPERA CIS [信息共享计算机系统]。
target_text: The response team reviewed OPERA CIS [Computer Information System for information sharing] after a cluster of fever cases exposed a weakness in planning for the damaged ferry crossing.

source_text: 官员在请求区域待命资产前检查了SASOP [区域待命安排标准作业程序]。
target_text: Officials checked SASOP [Standard Operating Procedures for Regional Standby Arrangements] before requesting regional standby assets.

source_text: 在情景推演期间，军事资产部署依据SASOP Chapter VI [军事资产便利化和使用条款]进行了审查。
target_text: Military asset deployment was reviewed against SASOP Chapter VI [Section governing facilitation and utilization of military assets] during the scenario.

source_text: 法律顾问在解释东盟灾害响应机制时引用了AADMER [东盟灾害管理与应急响应协定]。
target_text: The legal advisor cited AADMER [ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response] when explaining ASEAN disaster response mechanisms.

source_text: 情景设计团队为洪水响应演习改编了一个ARDEX [东盟区域灾害应急响应模拟演习]注入事件。
target_text: The scenario design team adapted an ARDEX [ASEAN Regional Disaster Emergency Response Simulation Exercise] inject for the flood response exercise.

source_text: 后勤SME [主题专家]警告说，港口可能在数小时内成为瓶颈。
target_text: The logistics SME [Subject Matter Expert] warned that the port could become a bottleneck within hours.

source_text: 在AAR [行动后检讨]期间，参与者指出联络官需要更清晰的交接说明。
target_text: During the AAR [After Action Review], participants noted that liaison officers needed clearer handover notes.

source_text: 使用GenAI [生成式AI]起草的报告仍需由人工行动人员审查。
target_text: Reports drafted with GenAI [Generative AI] still required review by human operational staff.

source_text: 晚间更新纳入了PLA [中国人民解放军]，因为社区反馈同时影响地方规划和区域协调。
target_text: The evening update included PLA [People's Liberation Army] because community feedback affected both local planning and regional coordination.

source_text: 由Sentinel-1 [卫星成像计划]生成的洪水地图帮助确认哪些道路仍可通行。
target_text: Flood maps derived from Sentinel-1 [Satellite imaging program] helped confirm which roads were still passable.

source_text: 桥梁受损影响下游村庄社区后，响应时间表围绕Copernicus [卫星成像计划]进行了调整。
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around Copernicus [Satellite imaging program] once bridge damage affected communities in the downstream villages.

source_text: 缺失的受益人名单暴露出偏远公社集合点规划弱点后，响应团队审查了Digital Twin [用于仿真精度的虚拟复制项目]。
target_text: The response team reviewed Digital Twin [Proposed virtual replica project for simulation accuracy] after a missing beneficiary list exposed a weakness in planning for the remote commune assembly point.

source_text: 通信中断改变响应假设后，协调简报引用了MOT [交通运输部]的输入。
target_text: The coordination brief cited inputs from MOT [Ministry of Transport] after telecommunications outages changed the response assumptions.

source_text: 规划小组使用Interoperability [不同系统交换数据的能力]来决定沿海渔村是否需要更简明的决策简报。
target_text: The planning cell used Interoperability [Ability of different systems to exchange data] to decide whether coastal fishing villages needed a simpler decision brief.

source_text: 对于高地滑坡走廊，Information Overload [高峰影响期管理大量数据的挑战]为团队提供了一种方法，用来比较救护车组短缺与其他响应风险。
target_text: For the upland landslide corridor, Information Overload [Challenge of managing high data volumes during peak impact] gave the team a way to compare a shortage of ambulance crews with other response risks.

source_text: 新的联络官到达后，协调小组更新了ToR [职权范围]。
target_text: The coordination cell updated its ToR [Terms of Reference] after new liaison officers arrived.

source_text: 指挥官在向伙伴单位分配任务前介绍了CONOPS [行动构想]。
target_text: The commander briefed the CONOPS [Concept of Operations] before assigning tasks to partner units.

source_text: 每一项援助提议在接受前都通过NFP [国家联络点]转办。
target_text: Every offer of assistance was routed through the NFP [National Focal Point] before acceptance.

source_text: 当聚集性发热病例使东部医院服务区规划更难预测时，联络官采用了HADR [人道主义援助与灾害救援]。
target_text: liaison officers applied HADR [Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] when a cluster of fever cases made planning for the eastern hospital catchment less predictable.

source_text: 区级官员在协调避难所报告与受损港区通行限制时，咨询了Changi RHCC [樟宜区域人道主义援助与灾害救援协调中心]。
target_text: District officials consulted Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the damaged port area.

source_text: 在批准下一项支援包前，规划人员请求US INDOPACOM [美国印度洋-太平洋司令部]确认哪些地方的分发时间需要调整。
target_text: Before approving the next support package, planners asked US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] to confirm where distribution timing needed adjustment.

source_text: CFE-DM [灾害管理与人道主义援助卓越中心]的一份联络说明澄清了在伙伴支援转向洪泛平原聚落前，哪些请求已获得验证。
target_text: A liaison note from CFE-DM [Center for Excellence in Disaster Management and Humanitarian Assistance] clarified which requests were validated before partner support moved toward the floodplain settlements.

source_text: VDDMA更新显示，尽管降雨总量下降，一段河流仍高于危险水位。
target_text: VDDMA updates showed that one river section remained above danger level despite falling rainfall totals.

source_text: 在MOT确认次要路线开放后，VPA卡车将救援货物运至前沿枢纽。
target_text: VPA trucks transported relief cargo to a forward hub after MOT confirmed that the secondary route was open.

source_text: MARD报告说，一旦撤离行动稳定，牲畜疾病预防将变得重要。
target_text: MARD reported that livestock disease prevention would become important once evacuation operations stabilized.

source_text: MOT警告车队规划人员，修复后的桥梁可承载救护车，但不能承载满载货车。
target_text: MOT warned convoy planners that a repaired bridge could support ambulances but not fully loaded cargo trucks.

source_text: MOH请求就避难所疾病监测和患者转诊程序与WHO开展额外协调。
target_text: MOH requested additional coordination with WHO on shelter disease surveillance and patient referral procedures.

source_text: DRRP成员确定了与早期预警、撤离演练和本地储备有关的备灾经验。
target_text: DRRP members identified preparedness lessons related to early warning, evacuation drills, and local stockpiles.

source_text: QPT支持的设备使村庄团队能够在国家响应人员抵达前开始清理小型排水沟。
target_text: QPT-supported equipment allowed village teams to begin clearing small drains before national responders arrived.

source_text: VNRC志愿者分享了受益人反馈，促使规划人员调整两个撤离中心的配送时间。
target_text: VNRC volunteers shared beneficiary feedback that led planners to adjust delivery times at two evacuation centres.

source_text: VAMS在晚间简报前向卫生小组更新了医院氧气水平、救护车排队情况和转运能力。
target_text: VAMS updated the health cell on hospital oxygen levels, ambulance queues, and transfer capacity before the evening briefing.

source_text: WoG协调防止在撤离时间、道路限制和避难所健康预防措施方面出现相互矛盾的公共信息。
target_text: WoG coordination prevented conflicting public messages on evacuation timing, road restrictions, and shelter health precautions.

source_text: NDMO在协调省级报告和现场评估结果后，最终确定了正式需求清单。
target_text: The NDMO finalized the official needs list after reconciling provincial reports with field assessment findings.

source_text: CMCoord工作人员帮助确保军事工程支援被分配给通行恢复，而不是一般性建设工作。
target_text: CMCoord staff helped ensure military engineering support was assigned to access restoration rather than general construction work.

source_text: NFP在确认本地资源已满足已识别需求后，关闭了若干待处理支援提议。
target_text: The NFP closed several pending offers after confirming that local resources had already met the identified requirements.

source_text: HADR协调员在分配后续行动前，将紧急需求归入救援、卫生、后勤、避难所和WASH类别。
target_text: HADR coordinators grouped urgent needs into rescue, health, logistics, shelter, and WASH categories before assigning follow-up actions.

source_text: Changi RHCC向伙伴联络官简报了已接受援助、剩余缺口以及仍等待东道国批准的能力。
target_text: The Changi RHCC briefed partner liaison officers on accepted assistance, remaining gaps, and capabilities still awaiting host-nation approval.

source_text: 文职主管部门确认若干地区仍无法通过道路通行后，US INDOPACOM提供了空中运输规划支援。
target_text: US INDOPACOM offered planning support for air movement after civilian authorities confirmed that several districts remained inaccessible by road.

source_text: CFE-DM参考说明帮助评估团队识别协调问题源于角色不清还是信息流不畅。
target_text: CFE-DM reference notes helped the evaluation team identify whether coordination problems came from unclear roles or poor information flow.

source_text: 受灾国确认净水和临时避难方面存在额外需求后，AHA Centre更新了区域伙伴。
target_text: The AHA Centre updated regional partners after the affected state confirmed additional needs for water purification and temporary shelter.

source_text: UN OCHA与集群代表合作，将冗长的现场输入转化为一组简明的人道主义优先事项。
target_text: UN OCHA worked with cluster representatives to turn lengthy field inputs into a concise set of humanitarian priorities.

source_text: ASEAN-ERAT在建议流动诊所是否应先访问孤立村庄前，核实了社区领导的报告。
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT verified reports from community leaders before recommending whether mobile clinics should visit the isolated villages first.

source_text: ACMC指导帮助军官理解为什么速度、可见度和控制必须与人道主义原则保持平衡。
target_text: ACMC guidance helped military officers understand why speed, visibility, and control must be balanced with humanitarian principles.

source_text: PDC分析人员比较风暴路径预报和暴露人口数据，标记需要加强早期预警的沿海地区。
target_text: PDC analysts compared storm-track forecasts with exposed population data to flag coastal districts needing early warning reinforcement.

source_text: WHO建议避难所卫生台监测失去常规药物获取渠道的慢性病患者。
target_text: WHO advised the shelter health desk to monitor chronic disease patients who had lost access to regular medication.

source_text: WFP安排了分流配送计划，使食品库存能够送达大型避难所和较小的非正式地点。
target_text: WFP arranged a split delivery plan so food stocks could reach both large shelters and smaller informal sites.

source_text: ISCG要求每个部门在下一次协调电话会议前报告主要限制、可用能力和所需决策。
target_text: The ISCG asked each sector to report top constraints, available capacity, and decisions required before the next coordination call.

source_text: USAID BHA讨论了伙伴覆盖地图，以确保捐助资助活动不会遗漏需求区域。
target_text: USAID BHA discussed partner coverage maps to ensure donor-funded activities did not leave overlooked pockets of need.

source_text: ADMM-Plus成员审查了区域军事合作如何在保留受灾国领导权的同时支持灾害响应。
target_text: ADMM-Plus members reviewed how regional military cooperation could support disaster response while preserving affected-state leadership.

source_text: EWG on HADR研究了通用模板是否能改善伙伴部队报告可用资产的方式。
target_text: The EWG on HADR examined whether common templates could improve the way partner forces reported available assets.

source_text: INSARAG协调程序为抵达的救援队提供了共同的现场分诊和工作点分配方法。
target_text: INSARAG coordination procedures gave arriving rescue teams a shared method for site triage and worksite assignment.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat汇编了区域会议的后续任务，以便演习后进行跟踪。
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat compiled follow-up tasks from the regional meeting so they could be tracked after the exercise.

source_text: AMRG on HADR代表比较了用于医疗后送、运输、工程和净水支援的部队组合。
target_text: AMRG on HADR representatives compared force packages for medical evacuation, transport, engineering, and water purification support.

source_text: SAF规划人员在建议航班排序前，审查了跑道状况、货物处理能力和机场拥堵情况。
target_text: SAF planners reviewed runway conditions, cargo handling capacity, and airfield congestion before recommending flight sequencing.

source_text: PLA联络官从桥梁评估、瓦砾清除和临时通行恢复等方面说明了工程能力。
target_text: The PLA liaison described engineering capabilities in terms of bridge assessment, debris clearance, and temporary access restoration.

source_text: JOCCA将区域援助更新转化为一份面向受灾国决策者的单一协调简报。
target_text: JOCCA translated regional assistance updates into a single coordination brief for the affected state's decision-makers.

source_text: SCDF导师强调，余震期间队伍进入部分坍塌建筑前需要严格的安全检查。
target_text: SCDF mentors emphasized the need for disciplined safety checks before teams entered partially collapsed buildings during aftershocks.

source_text: VINASARCOM在批准第二波国际援助提议前，请求更新省级报告。
target_text: VINASARCOM requested updated provincial reports before approving a second wave of international assistance offers.

source_text: VDDMA工程人员警告，即使降雨总量开始下降，饱和的堤岸仍可能失效。
target_text: VDDMA engineers warned that saturated embankments could fail even if rainfall totals began to decline.

source_text: VPA单位支持路线清障，同时地方官员确定哪些社区最需要道路先行恢复。
target_text: VPA units supported route clearance while local officials identified which communities needed the road reopened first.

source_text: MARD报告说，受损灌溉水泵可能在紧急避难所关闭后长期延误农业恢复。
target_text: MARD reported that damaged irrigation pumps could delay agricultural recovery long after emergency shelters closed.

source_text: MOT交通管理人员与警方协调，管控车队通过狭窄且部分受损道路的行动。
target_text: MOT traffic managers coordinated with police to control convoy movement through narrow and partially damaged roads.

source_text: MOH要求医院每四小时报告氧气库存、创伤容量和救护车延误情况。
target_text: MOH asked hospitals to report oxygen stocks, trauma capacity, and ambulance delays every four hours.

source_text: DRRP成员建议利用响应经验，在下一次台风季前加强地方备灾计划。
target_text: DRRP members proposed using response lessons to strengthen local preparedness plans before the next typhoon season.

source_text: QPT对村庄预警系统的投入帮助居民在洪水到达主通道前撤离。
target_text: QPT investments in village warning systems helped residents evacuate before floodwater reached the main access road.

source_text: VNRC团队收集了关于配送时间、避难所条件和失联家庭成员的社区反馈。
target_text: VNRC teams collected community feedback on distribution timing, shelter conditions, and missing family members.

source_text: 两家区级医院报告救护车排队和手术能力有限后，VAMS识别出转诊瓶颈。
target_text: VAMS identified referral bottlenecks after two district hospitals reported ambulance queues and limited surgical capacity.

source_text: WoG规划帮助各部委解决道路清障、医院支援、食品配送和避难所管理之间相互竞争的优先事项。
target_text: WoG planning helped ministries resolve competing priorities between road clearance, hospital support, food delivery, and shelter management.

source_text: NDMO在向伙伴分享任务建议前，通过正式需求清单筛选国际支援提议。
target_text: The NDMO filtered international offers through the official needs list before sharing tasking recommendations with partners.

source_text: CMCoord工作人员解释了军用卡车如何在不改变文职分发计划的情况下支持人道主义配送。
target_text: CMCoord staff explained how military trucks could support humanitarian deliveries without changing the civilian distribution plan.

source_text: Mil-Mil沟通帮助伙伴分队协调集结区域，而不增加文职行动中心压力。
target_text: Mil-Mil communication helped partner contingents coordinate staging areas without adding pressure to the civilian operations centre.

source_text: Civ-Mil联络会议为地方非政府组织提供了在军事行动命令发布前提出通行问题的渠道。
target_text: Civ-Mil liaison meetings gave local NGOs a channel to raise access problems before military movement orders were issued.

source_text: 作为AS，政府确认所有入境团队将按照国家灾害管理优先事项行动。
target_text: As the AS, the government confirmed that all incoming teams would operate under national disaster management priorities.

source_text: MNCC从批准到完成跟踪外国军事支援请求，确保没有飞机或工程队被重复分配任务。
target_text: The MNCC tracked foreign military support requests from approval through completion so no aircraft or engineering team was double-tasked.

source_text: EOC管理人员利用区级更新决定撤离支援或医院补给是否需要立即升级。
target_text: EOC managers used district updates to decide whether evacuation support or hospital resupply needed immediate escalation.

source_text: 空运RFA说明了货物类型、乘客人数、装载点、目的地和时间敏感性。
target_text: The RFA for airlift described cargo type, passenger numbers, loading point, destination, and time sensitivity.

source_text: COP包含洪水地图、道路报告、避难所数据和医院容量估计的置信度。
target_text: The COP included confidence levels for flood maps, road reports, shelter figures, and hospital capacity estimates.

source_text: 当天气条件使夜间搜索对响应人员过于危险时，SAR队伍暂停了河上行动。
target_text: SAR teams coordinated with village leaders to identify homes where residents might have ignored evacuation orders.

source_text: USAR队伍在进入河滨附近受损办公楼前，请求更新结构信息。
target_text: USAR crews requested updated structural information before entering the damaged office block near the riverfront.

source_text: 风和潮汐数据一夜之间改变漂移估计后，MSAR规划人员调整了搜索区域。
target_text: MSAR planners adjusted the search area after wind and tide data changed overnight drift estimates.

source_text: CBRE响应人员在获得空气监测结果前，在仓库周边建立了安全警戒线。
target_text: CBRE responders established a safety perimeter around the warehouse until air monitoring results were available.

source_text: IOI板列出了关于救援航班排序、海关延误、避难所拥挤和公共信息发布的未决事项。
target_text: The IOI board listed unresolved decisions on relief flight sequencing, customs delays, shelter crowding, and public messaging.

source_text: WASH伙伴优先考虑安全储水，因为一些家庭在撤离中心重复使用受污染容器。
target_text: WASH partners prioritized safe water storage because some families were reusing contaminated containers in evacuation centres.

source_text: 河中岛村落报告一夜之间发生变化后，后勤文员将NFI与更好的交接说明联系起来。
target_text: logistics clerks linked NFI to a better handover note after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: HOC在人道主义伙伴向军事协调单元简报前，收集了保护方面的关切。
target_text: The HOC gathered protection concerns from humanitarian partners before briefing the military coordination element.

source_text: LCC官员在放行卡车前，将车队能力与紧急货物请求进行了比较。
target_text: LCC officers compared convoy capacity with urgent cargo requests before releasing trucks to the forward hub.

source_text: AIC推迟了一次勘测无人机任务，直到医疗后送直升机离开附近空中走廊。
target_text: The AIC delayed a survey drone mission until medical evacuation helicopters cleared the nearby air corridor.

source_text: MASCAS注入事件测试了当两家医院同时达到容量上限时，救护车调度员能否安排患者路线。
target_text: MASCAS injects tested whether ambulance dispatchers could route patients when two hospitals reached capacity simultaneously.

source_text: 互认机制帮助东道国整合认证救援队，而无需重复完整资质审查。
target_text: Mutual Recognition helped the host nation integrate certified rescue teams without repeating full qualification reviews.

source_text: APOD团队设立了人员接收、货物处理和后续运输分配的独立通道。
target_text: The APOD team created separate lanes for personnel reception, cargo handling, and onward transport assignment.

source_text: SPOD管理人员将重型设备卸载安排在夜间，以减少对白天救援货物运输的干扰。
target_text: SPOD managers scheduled heavy equipment offload at night to reduce interference with daytime relief cargo movement.

source_text: 工程人员安装临时排水设施并清除最陡路段的泥土后，MSR重新开放。
target_text: The MSR reopened after engineers installed temporary drainage and cleared mud from the steepest section.

source_text: 入境团队在出发前提交设备清单、医疗物资和护照信息后，CIQ处理得到改善。
target_text: CIQ processing improved when incoming teams submitted equipment lists, medical supplies, and passport details before departure.

source_text: MCDA请求仅限于文职响应人员无法以现有资源处理的时间敏感缺口。
target_text: MCDA requests were limited to time-sensitive gaps that civilian responders could not address with available resources.

source_text: HuMOCC原则为协调小组讨论军事支援人道主义任务提供了中立语言。
target_text: HuMOCC principles gave the coordination cell a neutral language for discussing military support to humanitarian tasks.

source_text: DVI人员与地方主管部门合作，记录失踪人员信息并以尊重方式管理身份识别程序。
target_text: DVI personnel worked with local authorities to record missing-person information and manage identification procedures respectfully.

source_text: LEMA告知国家规划人员，一处列名撤离中心没有供水，不应再接收更多家庭。
target_text: LEMA informed national planners that one listed evacuation centre had no water supply and should not receive more families.

source_text: Ex COORES评估员观察参与者多快识别重复支援提议并将支援转向未满足需求。
target_text: Ex COORES evaluators observed how quickly participants recognized duplicated offers and redirected support to unmet needs.

source_text: TTX要求官员在医疗物资空运和受损桥梁工程支援之间确定优先顺序。
target_text: The TTX challenged officials to prioritize between airlift for medical supplies and engineering support for a damaged bridge.

source_text: OPERA CIS条目帮助信息团队看清哪些请求在分配任务前需要澄清。
target_text: OPERA CIS entries helped the information team see which requests needed clarification before they could be tasked.

source_text: SASOP指导支持了关于如何请求、便利和报告东盟待命安排的讨论。
target_text: SASOP guidance supported the discussion on how ASEAN standby arrangements should be requested, facilitated, and reported.

source_text: SASOP Chapter VI帮助法律顾问解释接收和协调外国军事资产的要求。
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI helped legal advisers explain requirements for receiving and coordinating foreign military assets.

source_text: AADMER被用作区域合作、相互援助和信息共享的政策参考。
target_text: AADMER was used as the policy reference for regional cooperation, mutual assistance, and information sharing.

source_text: ARDEX经验影响了纳入港口中断、洪水和公共卫生同时注入事件的决定。
target_text: ARDEX lessons influenced the decision to include simultaneous port disruption, flooding, and public health injects.

source_text: SME建议未来情景在报告高峰期对信息管理人员施加更大压力。
target_text: The SME recommended that future scenarios include more pressure on information managers during peak reporting periods.

source_text: AAR识别出联络班次交接、任务关闭程序和部门摘要质量方面的缺口。
target_text: The AAR identified gaps in liaison shift handovers, task closure procedures, and the quality of sector summaries.

source_text: GenAI生成了态势摘要的初稿，但分析人员逐行核对了已核实报告。
target_text: GenAI produced a first draft of the situation summary, but analysts checked every line against verified reports.

source_text: LLM帮助将技术评估说明转化为用于协调简报的通俗语言更新。
target_text: The LLM helped convert technical assessment notes into plain-language updates for the coordination briefing.

source_text: 当地面巡逻无法到达北部河流流域时，Sentinel-1雷达图像支持了洪水制图。
target_text: Sentinel-1 radar imagery supported flood mapping when ground patrols could not reach the northern river basin.

source_text: Copernicus产品帮助比较全省受影响聚落、受损道路和可能的通行限制。
target_text: Copernicus products helped compare affected settlements, damaged roads, and likely access constraints across the province.

source_text: Digital Twin让规划人员能够测试移动集结区是否会缩短配送时间。
target_text: The Digital Twin allowed planners to test whether moving the staging area would shorten delivery times.

source_text: Hybrid Exercise将政策层面的问题解决与模拟机场的现场接收任务结合起来。
target_text: The Hybrid Exercise combined policy-level problem solving with field-level reception tasks at the simulated airport.

source_text: 所有团队使用相同的电子表格标题和区级标识后，Interoperability问题减少了。
target_text: Interoperability problems decreased once all teams used the same spreadsheet headings and district identifiers.

source_text: 未经筛选的照片、原始笔记和重复报告到达高级简报团队时，Information Overload增加。
target_text: Information Overload increased when unfiltered photographs, raw notes, and duplicate reports reached the senior briefing team.

source_text: ToR要求每个小组负责人提供简明更新，并识别需要领导层关注的决策。
target_text: The ToR required each cell lead to provide concise updates and identify decisions that needed leadership attention.

source_text: 新的天气预报缩短了直升机行动可用窗口后，CONOPS假设被修订。
target_text: CONOPS assumptions were revised after new weather forecasts shortened the available window for helicopter operations.

source_text: NFP只有在确认新支援提议是否匹配最新已验证需求清单后，才予以确认。
target_text: The NFP acknowledged new offers only after confirming whether they matched the latest validated needs list.

source_text: 救援行动结束、避难所服务成为主要优先事项后，HADR团队从快速响应转向稳定阶段。
target_text: HADR teams shifted from rapid response to stabilization once rescue operations ended and shelter services became the main priority.

source_text: Changi RHCC通过比较伙伴能力和已接受RFA，帮助维持区域态势感知。
target_text: The Changi RHCC helped maintain regional situational awareness by comparing partner capabilities with accepted RFAs.

source_text: US INDOPACOM规划人员分享飞机限制，以便MNCC避免分配不适合的货运任务。
target_text: US INDOPACOM planners shared aircraft constraints so the MNCC could avoid assigning unsuitable cargo missions.

source_text: CFE-DM材料支持了一场关于为何信息纪律在快速发展的多国行动中至关重要的讨论。
target_text: CFE-DM materials supported a discussion on why information discipline matters during fast-moving multinational operations.

source_text: AHA Centre与NDMO协调，向东盟伙伴更新后勤缺口和避难所优先事项。
target_text: The AHA Centre coordinated with the NDMO to update ASEAN partners on logistics gaps and shelter priorities.

source_text: UN OCHA帮助伙伴准备关于人道主义通行和公正援助的联合信息。
target_text: UN OCHA helped partners prepare a joint message on humanitarian access and impartial assistance.

source_text: ASEAN-ERAT调查结果显示，一些村庄比额外食品供应更急需医疗外展服务。
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT findings showed that some villages needed medical outreach more urgently than additional food supplies.

source_text: ACMC顾问鼓励规划人员在军事资产用于文职救援任务时记录相关假设。
target_text: ACMC advisers encouraged planners to document assumptions whenever military assets were used for civilian relief tasks.

source_text: PDC建模强调，一个地区同时面临洪水暴露和撤离路线冗余不足的问题。
target_text: PDC modelling highlighted that one district faced both flood exposure and limited evacuation-route redundancy.

source_text: WHO建议卫生团队绘制透析、孕产护理和创伤治疗的转诊选项图。
target_text: WHO recommended that health teams map referral options for dialysis, maternity care, and trauma treatment.

source_text: 商业卡车运力成为主要行动限制后，WFP与地方运输服务商进行了协调。
target_text: WFP coordinated with local transport providers after commercial trucking capacity became a major operational constraint.

source_text: ISCG整合部门需求，使捐助方无需阅读单独的技术报告即可比较紧急缺口。
target_text: The ISCG consolidated sector needs so donors could compare urgent gaps without reading separate technical reports.

source_text: USAID BHA审查拟议活动是否包含与地方主管部门的协调以及现实的交付时间表。
target_text: USAID BHA reviewed whether proposed activities included coordination with local authorities and realistic delivery timelines.

source_text: ADMM-Plus观察员指出，在情景中的行动压力增加前，共同程序改善了信任。
target_text: ADMM-Plus observers noted that common procedures improved trust before operational pressure increased during the scenario.

source_text: EWG on HADR建议在区域演习中更频繁地演练多国后勤协调。
target_text: The EWG on HADR recommended more frequent rehearsal of multinational logistics coordination during regional exercises.

source_text: 当多支救援队抵达同一坍塌结构时，INSARAG工作点管理减少了混乱。
target_text: INSARAG worksite management reduced confusion when multiple rescue teams arrived at the same collapsed structure.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat保存了正式决策记录，以便未来区域HADR会议跟进。
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat preserved the official record of decisions for follow-up during future regional HADR meetings.

source_text: AMRG on HADR参与者研究可部署单位是否具备足够的自我保障能力开展偏远行动。
target_text: AMRG on HADR participants examined whether deployable units had enough self-sustainment for remote operations.

source_text: SAF团队分享了将医疗后送规划与机场接收程序整合的经验。
target_text: SAF teams shared experience on integrating medical evacuation planning with airfield reception procedures.

source_text: PLA工程人员在承诺向受损河流渡口投入设备前，请求提供本地测绘数据。
target_text: PLA engineers requested local survey data before committing equipment to the damaged river crossing.

source_text: JOCCA帮助识别何时应重定向区域支援提议，因为原始需求已经得到满足。
target_text: JOCCA helped identify when a regional offer should be redirected because the original need had already been met.

source_text: SCDF教官在夜间演习前，与地方队伍审查了技术救援通信规程。
target_text: SCDF instructors reviewed technical rescue communication protocols with local teams before the night exercise.

source_text: VINASARCOM协调国家批准，避免国际伙伴分别与多个省份谈判。
target_text: VINASARCOM coordinated national approvals so international partners would not negotiate separately with multiple provinces.

source_text: VDDMA更新帮助撤离规划人员预判大坝泄洪后哪些低洼地区可能再次被淹。
target_text: VDDMA updates helped evacuation planners anticipate which low-lying areas could flood again after dam releases.

source_text: VPA后勤支援使救援物资能够运过文职卡车无法安全通行的位置。
target_text: VPA logistics support allowed relief items to move beyond the point where civilian trucks could safely operate.

source_text: MARD损害报告支持动物卫生、种子补充和灌溉系统恢复规划。
target_text: MARD damage reports supported planning for animal health, seed replacement, and restoration of irrigation systems.

source_text: MOT通知LCC，两条次要道路仅对轻型车辆开放。
target_text: MOT informed the LCC that two secondary roads were open only to light vehicles.

source_text: MOH要求卫生协调小组为未来一周避难所相关疾病增加做好准备。
target_text: MOH asked the health coordination cell to prepare for increased shelter-related illness over the next week.

source_text: DRRP伙伴提出基于早期预警和撤离行为中观察到的缺口开展社区培训。
target_text: DRRP partners proposed community training based on gaps observed in early warning and evacuation behavior.

source_text: QPT支持的备灾活动帮助地方志愿者在国家资源抵达前管理初步撤离。
target_text: QPT-supported preparedness activities helped local volunteers manage initial evacuation before national resources arrived.

source_text: VNRC分会工作人员帮助避难所管理人员识别失散儿童、老年撤离人员和需要特殊援助的家庭。
target_text: VNRC branch staff helped shelter managers identify separated children, older evacuees, and families requiring special assistance.

source_text: VAMS建议在EOC使用的共享卫生仪表板中增加救护车状态指标。
target_text: VAMS recommended adding ambulance status indicators to the shared health dashboard used by the EOC.

source_text: 当各部委必须就撤离、道路封闭和健康预防措施发布联合指令时，WoG协调减少了混乱。
target_text: WoG coordination reduced confusion when ministries had to issue joint instructions on evacuation, road closures, and health precautions.

source_text: NDMO要求伙伴澄清其支援提议是否包括运输、燃油、口译员和自我保障。
target_text: The NDMO asked partners to clarify whether their offers included transport, fuel, interpreters, and self-sustainment.

source_text: CMCoord讨论帮助将笼统的支援请求转化为卡车、直升机和工程人员的具体任务。
target_text: CMCoord discussions helped convert a broad request for support into specific tasks for trucks, helicopters, and engineers.

source_text: Mil-Mil渠道在拥堵影响人道主义空中行动前，消除了直升机停放和加油安排冲突。
target_text: Mil-Mil channels deconflicted helicopter parking and refuelling before congestion affected humanitarian air movements.

source_text: Civ-Mil协调确保车队行动不会阻碍通往文职分发点的通行。
target_text: Civ-Mil coordination ensured that convoy movements did not block access to civilian distribution points.

source_text: AS要求所有国际团队在离开指定区域前共享每日计划。
target_text: The AS requested that all international teams share daily plans before moving outside assigned areas.

source_text: MNCC与HOC协调，确保军事后勤支援符合文职人道主义优先事项。
target_text: The MNCC coordinated with the HOC to ensure military logistics support aligned with civilian humanitarian priorities.

source_text: 现场团队确认三座桥梁仅可供小型车辆通行后，EOC工作人员更新了事件地图。
target_text: EOC staff updated the incident map after field teams confirmed three bridges were usable only for small vehicles.

source_text: WASH报告显示避难所健康风险上升后，一份净水支援RFA被列为优先事项。
target_text: An RFA for water treatment support was prioritized after WASH reports showed rising health risks in shelters.

source_text: COP帮助领导层在选择下一步行动优先事项前，将已核实需求与可用资产进行比较。
target_text: The COP helped leaders compare verified needs against available assets before choosing the next operational priorities.

source_text: 地方主管部门确认即时危及生命的救援已完成后，SAR行动转入二次搜索。
target_text: SAR operations moved to secondary search after local authorities confirmed that immediate life-threatening rescues were complete.

source_text: 当一栋建筑内的搜索行动从救援转为恢复时，USAR队伍与DVI专家进行了协调。
target_text: USAR teams coordinated with DVI specialists when search operations shifted from rescue to recovery in one building.

source_text: 天气条件使原搜索网格不安全后，MSAR单位调整了船只搜索模式。
target_text: MSAR units adjusted boat patterns after weather conditions made the original search grid unsafe.

source_text: 在仓库场地获准作为临时救援储存点前，CBRE危害已被排除。
target_text: CBRE hazards were ruled out before the warehouse site was approved for temporary relief storage.

source_text: IOI跟踪表帮助决策者看清哪些问题需要政策指导，而不是常规行动处理。
target_text: The IOI tracker helped decision-makers see which issues required policy guidance rather than routine operational action.

source_text: WASH团队与MOH协调，因为避难所卫生条件差可能很快演变为公共卫生问题。
target_text: WASH teams coordinated with MOH because poor sanitation in shelters could quickly become a public health problem.

source_text: NFI库存水平在规划人员承诺追加毛毯、卫生包和厨房套装前得到更新。
target_text: NFI stock levels were updated before planners committed additional blankets, hygiene kits, and kitchen sets.

source_text: HOC上报了后勤报告中看不到的关于分发公平性的社区关切。
target_text: The HOC escalated community concerns about distribution equity that were not visible in logistics reports.

source_text: LCC规划人员根据货物紧急程度、目的地通行情况和卸载能力分配稀缺卡车。
target_text: LCC planners assigned scarce trucks based on cargo urgency, destination access, and unloading capacity.

source_text: AIC协调防止一次无人机制图飞行与同一路线上的直升机医疗后送发生冲突。
target_text: AIC coordination prevented a drone mapping sortie from conflicting with helicopter medical evacuation along the same route.

source_text: 当演习引入桥梁坍塌和洪水造成的同时伤害时，MASCAS程序指导了分诊。
target_text: MASCAS procedures guided triage when the exercise introduced simultaneous injuries from a bridge collapse and flooding.

source_text: 互认机制让协调团队能够信任认证救援能力，同时仍由地方分配任务。
target_text: Mutual Recognition allowed the coordination team to trust certified rescue capabilities while still assigning missions locally.

source_text: APOD接收团队需要更清晰的标识，使抵达的响应人员能快速找到登记、简报和交通区域。
target_text: The APOD reception team needed clearer signage so arriving responders could find registration, briefing, and transport areas quickly.

source_text: SPOD延误迫使LCC在泊位重新开放后，优先确定哪些重型货物应先行运输。
target_text: SPOD delays forced the LCC to prioritize which heavy cargo should move first once the berth reopened.

source_text: MSR仍然脆弱，因为一处陡坡路段可能在降雨松动边坡后再次关闭。
target_text: The MSR remained vulnerable because one steep section could close again if rain loosened the slope.

source_text: CIQ官员与NFP协调，在不延误紧急队伍的情况下处理已批准救援人员。
target_text: CIQ officers coordinated with the NFP to process approved relief personnel without delaying urgent teams.

source_text: MCDA支援依据人道主义需求、文职能力和缺口可能持续时间进行审查。
target_text: MCDA support was reviewed against humanitarian need, civilian capacity, and the likely duration of the gap.

source_text: HuMOCC指导帮助避免军事规划人员参加人道主义协调会议时产生误解。
target_text: HuMOCC guidance helped prevent misunderstandings when military planners attended humanitarian coordination meetings.

source_text: DVI队伍请求口译员，以便准确且尊重地开展家庭访谈。
target_text: DVI teams requested interpreters so family interviews could be conducted accurately and respectfully.

source_text: LEMA报告说，村庄志愿者开设了一处尚未列入国家记录的新避难所。
target_text: LEMA reported that village volunteers had opened a new shelter not yet listed in national records.

source_text: Ex COORES控制员加入燃油短缺注入事件，以测试后勤优先排序和伙伴协调。
target_text: Ex COORES controllers added a fuel shortage inject to test logistics prioritization and partner coordination.

source_text: TTX显示，参与者需要更清晰的流程来关闭不再相关的请求。
target_text: The TTX showed that participants needed a clearer process for closing requests that were no longer relevant.

source_text: OPERA CIS帮助跟踪支援提议仍在等待东道国批准，还是已可分配任务。
target_text: OPERA CIS helped track whether offers were still pending host-nation approval or ready for tasking.

source_text: SASOP参考帮助团队将东盟支援程序与受灾国国家请求流程对齐。
target_text: SASOP references helped the team align ASEAN support procedures with the affected state's national request process.

source_text: 讨论军事设备应如何入境清关并转向指定任务时，引用了SASOP Chapter VI。
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI was cited when discussing how military equipment should clear entry and move to assigned tasks.

source_text: AADMER原则强化了区域援助应支持国家领导并加强成员国合作。
target_text: AADMER principles reinforced that regional assistance should support national leadership and strengthen cooperation among member states.

source_text: ARDEX经验帮助演习团队设计从响应行动向早期恢复规划过渡的现实情景。
target_text: ARDEX experience helped the exercise team design realistic transitions from response operations to early recovery planning.

source_text: 信息管理SME建议为高容量灾害期间建立简单的报告分诊系统。
target_text: The SME on information management recommended a simple report triage system for high-volume disaster periods.

source_text: AAR讨论强调需要更短的简报、更清晰的任务负责人以及更好的决策跟踪。
target_text: AAR discussions highlighted the need for shorter briefings, clearer task owners, and better tracking of decisions.

source_text: GenAI通过识别发布前需要紧急人工审查的报告，支持翻译分诊。
target_text: GenAI supported translation triage by identifying reports that needed urgent human review before dissemination.

source_text: LLM起草了避难所报告摘要，但信息管理人员在发布前删除了不确定的数据。
target_text: The LLM drafted a summary of shelter reports, but the information manager removed uncertain numbers before release.

source_text: Sentinel-1数据帮助规划人员识别出光学影像中被云层遮挡的被淹道路路段。
target_text: Sentinel-1 data helped planners identify flooded road segments hidden beneath cloud cover in optical imagery.

source_text: Copernicus制图支持将官方区级报告与独立遥感观测进行比较。
target_text: Copernicus mapping supported the comparison of official district reports with independent remote-sensing observations.

source_text: Digital Twin显示，将一个后勤枢纽移近海岸可改善配送时效。
target_text: The Digital Twin showed that moving one logistics hub closer to the coast could improve delivery timing.

source_text: Hybrid Exercise让远程规划人员测试政策决策，同时让现场团队练习货物接收。
target_text: The Hybrid Exercise allowed remote planners to test policy decisions while field teams practiced cargo reception.

source_text: 信息团队发布关于地名和数据格式的简短指南后，Interoperability得到改善。
target_text: Interoperability improved after the information team published a short guide on place names and data formats.

source_text: 当每个小组只提交所需决策、重大变化和关键限制时，Information Overload得到减少。
target_text: Information Overload was reduced when each cell submitted only decisions needed, major changes, and critical constraints.

source_text: ToR澄清，联络官应共享信息，而不是在已批准渠道之外独立分配资产任务。
target_text: The ToR clarified that liaison officers should share information, not independently task assets outside approved channels.

source_text: CONOPS制定包括港口关闭、机场拥堵、医院激增和新一轮洪水的分支计划。
target_text: CONOPS development included branch plans for port closure, airfield congestion, hospital surge, and renewed flooding.

source_text: NFP通知区域网络，两项已接受支援提议需要修订抵达时间。
target_text: The NFP informed the regional network that two accepted offers needed revised arrival times.

source_text: 规划小组使用HADR来决定洪水受损工业园区是否需要一份平衡的部门优先事项说明。
target_text: The planning cell used HADR to decide whether the flood-damaged industrial estate needed a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: Changi RHCC仪表板帮助显示哪些伙伴能力可在未来二十四小时内抵达。
target_text: The Changi RHCC dashboard helped show which partner capabilities could arrive within the next twenty-four hours.

source_text: 只有在道路和海上选项被评估为不足后，才考虑US INDOPACOM飞机支援。
target_text: US INDOPACOM aircraft support was considered only after road and sea options were assessed as insufficient.

source_text: CFE-DM观察员建议协调小组记录每项重大行动选择的理由。
target_text: CFE-DM observers recommended that the coordination cell record why each major operational choice was made.

source_text: AHA Centre帮助协调区域支援信息，使伙伴不会向受灾国发送相互矛盾的信息。
target_text: The AHA Centre helped align regional support messaging so partners did not send conflicting information to the affected state.

source_text: UN OCHA支持了一场人道主义优先事项讨论，将即时救命需求与早期恢复关切区分开来。
target_text: UN OCHA supported a humanitarian priorities discussion that separated immediate life-saving needs from early recovery concerns.

source_text: ASEAN-ERAT评估数据帮助NDMO细化哪些公社需要额外核实。
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT assessment data helped the NDMO refine which communes needed additional verification.

source_text: ACMC引导员帮助参与者练习用通俗语言向文职决策者解释军事支援选项。
target_text: ACMC facilitators helped participants practice explaining military support options to civilian decision-makers in plain language.

source_text: PDC暴露图帮助优先向河流、陡坡和受损道路附近社区发送预警信息。
target_text: PDC exposure maps helped prioritize warning messages for communities near rivers, steep slopes, and damaged roads.

source_text: WHO建议卫生伙伴在避难所外展计划中纳入心理健康和社会心理支持。
target_text: WHO advised health partners to include mental health and psychosocial support in shelter outreach plans.

source_text: WFP为可能在MSR再次关闭时被切断的社区规划备用食品配送。
target_text: WFP planned contingency food deliveries for communities that could be cut off if the MSR closed again.

source_text: ISCG要求伙伴在建议扩大避难所援助前更新受益人估算。
target_text: The ISCG asked partners to update beneficiary estimates before recommending an expansion of shelter assistance.

source_text: USAID BHA与其他捐助方协调，避免在同一撤离中心资助重叠活动。
target_text: USAID BHA coordinated with other donors to avoid funding overlapping activities in the same evacuation centres.

source_text: ADMM-Plus讨论强调灾害响应期间防务力量之间的实际互操作性，而不仅是战略对话。
target_text: ADMM-Plus discussions emphasized practical interoperability between defence forces during disaster response, not only strategic dialogue.

source_text: EWG on HADR将联络培训确定为多次区域演习中反复出现的需求。
target_text: The EWG on HADR identified liaison training as a recurring need across multiple regional exercises.

source_text: INSARAG协调帮助东道国在具备轻型、中型和重型能力的队伍之间划分救援工作。
target_text: INSARAG coordination helped the host nation divide rescue work between teams with light, medium, and heavy capabilities.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat向成员国和演习观察员共享了最终会议摘要。
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat shared the final meeting summary with member states and exercise observers.

source_text: AMRG on HADR成员比较了不同部队组合在正式请求后可多快部署。
target_text: AMRG on HADR members compared how quickly different force packages could deploy after official request.

source_text: 当叉车、巴士、医疗队和飞机共用有限停机坪空间时，SAF人员就安全货物流动提供建议。
target_text: SAF personnel advised on safe cargo flow when forklifts, buses, medical teams, and aircraft shared limited apron space.

source_text: PLA支援通过MNCC协调，以确保工程任务与国家优先事项保持一致。
target_text: PLA support was coordinated through the MNCC so engineering tasks remained aligned with national priorities.

source_text: JOCCA维护了一份区域援助矩阵，显示支援提议、任务状态和剩余协调缺口。
target_text: JOCCA maintained a regional assistance matrix that showed offers, tasking status, and remaining coordination gaps.

source_text: SCDF救援领导强调，在长时间搜索行动中进行疲劳管理的重要性。
target_text: SCDF rescue leaders stressed the importance of fatigue management during extended search operations.

source_text: VINASARCOM确认，省级主管部门应通过国家渠道报告需求，而不是直接请求外国队伍。
target_text: VINASARCOM confirmed that provincial authorities should report needs through national channels rather than directly requesting foreign teams.

source_text: VDDMA河流水位监测显示，洪峰到达下游地区的时间将晚于最初预期。
target_text: VDDMA river monitoring showed that flood peaks would reach downstream districts later than originally expected.

source_text: VPA支援帮助重新开放了一段连接两个撤离中心和最近医院的道路。
target_text: VPA support helped reopen a road segment that connected two evacuation centres with the nearest hospital.

source_text: MARD建议救援规划应考虑失去工具、种子和牲畜饲料的农民。
target_text: MARD advised that relief planning should account for farmers who lost tools, seed, and livestock feed.

source_text: MOT桥梁更新使车队规划人员能够将重型货物转移到更安全的路线。
target_text: MOT bridge updates allowed convoy planners to shift heavy cargo onto safer routes.

source_text: MOH与VAMS协调，将医院容量报告与救护车转运数据进行比较。
target_text: MOH coordinated with VAMS to compare hospital capacity reports with ambulance transfer data.

source_text: DRRP伙伴建议根据情景暴露出的缺口，加强社区灾害委员会建设。
target_text: DRRP partners recommended strengthening community disaster committees based on gaps revealed by the scenario.

source_text: QPT资金帮助维护本地撤离设备，这些设备在外部援助抵达前已被使用。
target_text: QPT funding helped maintain local evacuation equipment that was used before outside assistance arrived.

source_text: VNRC志愿者识别出需要补办证件、家庭寻人支持和基本救援物资的家庭。
target_text: VNRC volunteers identified households needing replacement documents, family tracing support, and basic relief items.

source_text: VAMS在演习最后一次协调会议前共享了医院激增容量摘要。
target_text: VAMS shared a hospital surge summary before the final coordination meeting of the exercise.

source_text: WoG协调帮助领导层将应急决策与交通、农业和公共卫生恢复规划联系起来。
target_text: WoG coordination helped leaders connect emergency decisions with recovery planning for transport, agriculture, and public health.

source_text: NDMO确认省级主管部门不再需要额外外部支援后，关闭了最后一项待处理请求。
target_text: The NDMO closed the last pending request after confirming that provincial authorities no longer required additional external support.

source_text: CMCoord工作人员记录了如何请求军事能力而不扰乱人道主义协调系统的经验教训。
target_text: CMCoord staff documented lessons on how to request military capabilities without disrupting humanitarian coordination systems.

source_text: NFP向伙伴更新，受灾国已接受净水支援，但拒绝了额外救援队。
target_text: The NFP updated partners that the affected state had accepted water treatment support but declined additional rescue teams.

source_text: 对Capacity Building [加强利益相关方响应能力的努力]的简短审查帮助无线电操作员解读夜间降雨激增，同时没有延误修正后的优先事项清单。
target_text: A short review of Capacity Building [Efforts to strengthen stakeholder response ability] helped radio operators interpret a night-time rainfall surge without delaying a corrected priority list.
